relations.definition: The subject was produced through an attributable operation using the object.
The subject is used as an attributable material ancestor of the object.
The subject is a later version of the object.
The subject revises an account while preserving the earlier version.
The subject is a bounded part of the object.
The subject contains the object as an explicitly bounded part.
The subject participates in a collection or corpus.
The subject representation was captured from the object under a declared apparatus.
The subject was produced through a declared transduction of the object.
The subject measurement used the object as evidence.
The subject was approached as the object under a declared listening pass.
The subject region or representation was segmented from the object.
The subject was isolated from the object through a declared method.
The subject texture or fragment set was produced by granulating the object under a declared grain scheme.
The subject and object participate in a declared mixture.
The subject combines lineage or conditioning from the object and other parents.
The subject was transformed by the object OperationReceipt.
The subject was generated by the object OperationReceipt.
The subject sonic control or render was mapped from the object observation or relation.
The subject was rendered as the object representation.
The subject process or score was performed as the object representation or event.
The subject is a declared causal parent of the object.
The subject is a declared causal child of the object.
The subject and object share declared parentage without implying perceptual identity.
The subject is an attributable variation of the object.
The subject temporally continues the object from a declared boundary.
The subject is situated in the object context or territory at a declared precision.
The subject representation was recorded at the object place or context.
The subject has a declared non-equivalent association with the object.
The subject carries an attribution to the object Actor.
The subject is stewarded under the responsibility of the object Actor.
The subject is governed by the object Policy.
The subject operation or disclosure was permitted by the object policy evaluation.
The subject is withheld under the object Policy or Actor decision.
The subject access or retention expired through the object policy event.
The subject claim supplies evidence supporting the object claim.
The subject and object make materially conflicting claims.
The subject differs from the object without requiring contradiction.
The current apparatus or terms do not authorize comparison between subject and object.
The subject is a declared speculative proposition about the object.
